title: Concordia measurement predicate v1
description: The predicate of an in-toto Statement v1 with predicateType https://concordia.io/evidence/measurement/v1: one measured value for a quality scenario. Concordia compares `value` with the scenario criterion itself and never reads a verdict from the producer. `metric`, `unit`, `threshold`, and `comparison` must equal the scenario criterion, or the measurement is inadmissible (`threshold-mismatch`, `unit-mismatch`). The schema is open: Concordia ignores fields that it does not list and does not persist them.

scenario.description: The id of the quality scenario.

testConditions.description: The conditions of the test, for example load and duration. Any value except null and an empty string.

outcome.description: Only `passed` is a measurement; another outcome is inadmissible with `failed-run`.

window.description: The measurement window. The maximum age counts from `end`.
